dict.string: Only if you connect Calendar in Doddy: to show today's events, answer what's on when you ask, and add an event after you tap Add.
Only if you connect Reminders in Doddy: to show what's due today and add a reminder after you tap Add.
Only if you connect Contacts in Doddy: to find a person by name when you ask. Numbers and e-mail addresses stay on your screen.
